scope: 管线现有两产物(拍摄+稀疏点云)的跨端压缩库;Android/鸿蒙实现推迟至有真机

capture_side.library: lib/pwva.dart(平台无关逻辑)+ lib/pwva_apple.dart(FFI 实现)
capture_side.api: PwvaWriter(流式,逐帧 flush,断点安全)/ PwvaReader(随机访问,只解本 GOP)
capture_side.platform_seam: HevcFrameEncoder/HevcFrameDecoder 接口;Android=AMediaCodec NDK C API,鸿蒙=OH_AVCodec C API,均待真机;接口文档中写死软编 HEVC 禁令
tests: GOP 边界验证(帧6只解3个AU)
截断归档无 finalize 仍可读(断点安全)
capture_side.measured: 96帧真实采集 11.81x,随机访问逐字节一致(见 streaming-archive-demo.json)

sparse_cloud_side.method: PLY头解析→SoA拆列→每列三候选变换(原样/字节面转置/32位差分+转置)→deflate9 取最小;结构不符回落 whole-file deflate
sparse_cloud_side.strict_lossless: 逐字节+长度+SHA-256;解压端 SHA 强制校验 fail closed
sparse_cloud_side.measured_on: official_sfm_sparse.ply 77,475点 (SHA ba941c8b…,与冻结合同一致)
sparse_cloud_side.tradeoff: 纯 Dart 零依赖 vs 差 8.6 个百分点;绝对差距 ~100KB/项目,相对照片层 230MB 的节省可忽略;要 ZPAQ 级可后续 FFI 挂 libzpaq(public domain)
test_highlights: 载荷/SHA/截断三类损坏 fail closed
ascii 与 list 属性回落模式仍无损
